conclusions: No requested fixed robust/local blend beats robust_only on pooled OOF RMSE.
Most remaining error is concentrated in a few shared outliers, especially ID49; seed and model residuals are strongly correlated.
The per-fold selected-checkpoint OOF score does not evaluate the same fixed epoch/optimizer-step schedule as the current full-data refit.

Global-epoch validation and full-data optimizer-step/EMA consistency merit a controlled experiment; six epochs is diagnostic evidence, not proof that changing test predictions will improve the online score.
Use a genuinely different appearance/preprocessing/model candidate to target shared outlier failures; more identical seeds or old local refinement alone have weak supporting evidence.
